## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like.

## Use Case

Describe the problem or use case this feature would address.

## Proposed Solution

A clear description of how you'd like this feature to work.

## ML Engine Impact (if applicable)

If this feature affects the ML engine:
- New features to add to the vector: [e.g., air pressure, pollen count]
- Literature references: [e.g., link to paper]
- Cross-platform parity considerations: [e.g., needs Swift + Kotlin implementation]

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or references about the feature request.

## Willingness to Contribute

- [ ] I'm willing to implement this feature myself
- [ ] I can help with testing
- [ ] I can provide domain expertise
